description_en: Creates a whitelist template that can be used across multiple products
description_zh: 创建用户跨产品白名单模板
kebab_example: aliyun das create-security-ip-group --region-name cn-beijing --global-ig-name test_123 --gip-list 192.168.0.1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSecurityIPGroup

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IP address whitelist template. The name must meet the following requirements:

Consists of lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).

Starts with a letter and ends with a letter or a digit.

Is 2 to 120 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
IP白名单模板名称。IP白名单模板名称需满足如下要求：

由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成。

由字母开头、字母或数字结尾。

长度为2~120个字符
parameters.name: global_ig_name

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist template.

Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). The IP addresses cannot be repeated. You can add up to 1,000 IP addresses
parameters.help_zh:
白名单模板内的IP地址。

多个IP地址需要用英文逗号（,）分隔，不可重复，上限为1000个
parameters.name: gip_list
